description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing medical consultations, including CRUD operations and role-based access control. It interacts with a MongoDB database to retrieve, create, update, and delete consultation records, tailored to user roles such as admin, doctor, and patient.

methods.name: Consultation _consultation_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB document into a Consultation model.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_patient_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the patient ID associated with a user ID.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_doctor_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the doctor ID associated with a user ID.

methods.name: List[Consultation] list_consultations(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict))
methods.description: Lists consultations for the current user based on their role.

methods.name: Consultation create_consultation( payload: ConsultationCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Creates a new consultation, with RBAC enforced for doctors and admins.

methods.name: Consultation get_consultation( consultation_id: str = Path(..., description="Consultation document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific consultation by ID, with permission checks for role-based access.

methods.name: Consultation update_consultation( consultation_id: str, payload: ConsultationUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Updates a consultation, restricted to admins or the assigned doctor.

methods.name: None delete_consultation( consultation_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a consultation, restricted to admin users.

ctags.name: create_consultation
ctags.signature: ( payload: ConsultationCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin", "doctor"])), )

ctags.name: get_consultation
ctags.signature: ( consultation_id: str = Path(..., description="Consultation document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )

ctags.name: update_consultation
ctags.signature: ( consultation_id: str, payload: ConsultationUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
